component.name: EZP2019 USB Programmer
component.summary: Native Qt 6 GUI for the EZP2019 USB EEPROM and SPI Flash programmer
Interface gráfica nativa em Qt 6 para o programador USB EZP2019 (EEPROM e SPI Flash)

description.p: EZP2019 USB Programmer is a native Linux Qt 6 desktop application for reading, writing, verifying, and erasing SPI Flash (25xx), I2C EEPROM (24xx), and Microwire EEPROM (93xx) chips using the EZP2019 High-Speed USB Programmer (VID 0x1fc8, PID 0x310b).

ul.li: Direct native integration with libezp2019 and libusb-1.0
Automatic USB device detection and non-blocking asynchronous read, program, verify, and erase operations
Database of 239 supported chips with cascading selectors and quick search by model or JEDEC ID
Dynamic 16-pin ZIF socket SVG placement diagram with Pin 1 orientation and 1.8V adapter warnings
Virtualized Hex and ASCII editor with binary (.bin) and Intel HEX (.hex) support, search, and live CRC32/MD5 checksums

description.p: Note: Accessing the EZP2019 USB programmer without root privileges requires installing a udev rule on the host system (/etc/udev/rules.d/99-ezp2019.rules) granting access to USB device 1fc8:310b.

screenshot.caption: EZP2019 USB Programmer hardware and interface

description.p: Initial Flatpak release with native Qt 6 GUI, 239 supported chips, dynamic ZIF socket diagram, and virtualized Hex/ASCII editor.
